laws.rule: Same-sex relationships are legal in DRC, with no specific laws criminalising it. laws.rule: A number of offences carry the death penalty, including terrorism and treason. Always carry a copy of your passport and visa or immigration permit. Police and immigration officials can ask to see your travel documents at any time. You must also stop when passing a government installation during the raising and lowering of the national flag. This happens at about 7:30am and 6pm every day. In the DRC it's illegal to: take photos of or near government buildings or other infrastructure, including airports take photos of a presidential or other official motorcade fail to produce your passport and visa or immigration permit on request
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: To drive in the DRC, you'll need both: a valid international driving permit (IDP) your current Australian driver's licence (digital driver's licences may not be accepted) You must get your IDP before you leave Australia.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Smartraveller advises Do not travel. A visa is needed before entering the DRC; there is no visa on arrival. The nearest DRC embassy is in Tokyo. A yellow fever certificate is required, and a departure tax applies when leaving by air.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: No online route on the official pages read: apply to a DRC embassy (nearest in Tokyo) before travel.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Get the visa before travel from a DRC embassy, carry a yellow fever certificate, and plan for health screening (Ebola outbreak) and declaring satellite phones and GPS equipment.

steps.step: Read the Do not travel advice; flights and border points can change with little warning.
Apply for a visa before travel at a DRC embassy (the nearest is in Tokyo): no visa on arrival.
Carry a yellow fever vaccination certificate; airlines may check it before boarding, on arrival and departure.
Declare satellite phones and GPS equipment on arrival.
On leaving by air, pay the airport exit fee and boarding fee, get official receipts and keep copies.
